baseline_observations: index-START.html had an empty <script> block and fixed font-size: 100px on h1.
Fixed font-size caused severe horizontal overflowing on narrow viewports (e.g. 360px mobile).

No prefers-reduced-motion media query or JavaScript motion gate was present; rapid pointer movements caused intense multi-colored shadow flashing without accommodating users with vestibular disorders.
The contenteditable h1 lacked an accessible, high-contrast focus outline for keyboard navigation.
decision: Implement the mousemove shadow calculation with prefers-reduced-motion detection in both CSS and JavaScript. Add responsive typography (clamp) and explicit high-contrast focus styling (:focus-visible) to keep controls usable and visible across 360px and 1280px viewports.
